Designed and shipped responsive web and mobile experiences for core HRMS products including Task Management, Timesheet, Leave and Attendance, translating user and business requirements into intuitive digital workflows.
Owned the end-to-end UX process across assigned modules, creating user flows, wireframes, interactive prototypes and development-ready high-fidelity interfaces in Figma.
Worked within existing product patterns and reusable components to maintain consistency across the HRMS platform while identifying opportunities to improve workflows and interaction patterns.
Collaborated with product stakeholders and developers to refine requirements, validate design feasibility and support implementation across desktop and mobile experiences.
Conducted interviews and usability testing with HR administrators, managers and employees, synthesizing findings into actionable UX improvements and interface decisions.
